timing: After the first nine previously published three-skill windows (six matched, 37 questions) and after the single earlier temporal-prefix relation recovery was verified, before fitting this policy. Use all 25 registered terminal interventions (209 questions). Report matched/excluded/pending, and the later evaluation subset separately from the assigned donor subset. No tunable value uses these endpoints. Earlier 12-window terminal-completion measurements and new activity-prefix relation outcomes stay outside this fit.
training: Fit two conditional scores in physical F1 units relative to the temporal skill. For the activity edge, use the archived cap-corrected raw terminal contrasts and the complete 43-row terminal credit archive; unknown raw returns remain missing. Use the 12 frozen current-source geometry coordinates and the actual preceding action. Center and scale geometry on the raw donor subset by equal history, equal source, then equal background, with SD floor .02, clip standardized coordinates to [-3,3] and divide by sqrt(12). For the relation edge, use all ten matched early temporal-prefix windows. Use the pre-frozen whole-source relation-vs-temporal affinity offset divided by two. Credit comes only from the complete twelve-window same-action repair audit, signed per-question effect divided by all window questions. A held history is excluded from both edges before constructing features, cyclic label rotation, weights and fits. Relation scores extrapolate across prefixes; mark that limitation.
loss: Start from direct weighted F1 ridge regression on each edge. Penalize slopes by .25 and intercept by .02 in the normal equations. Fit a second model with an auxiliary squared hinge per nonzero verified contrast, penalty equal to the raw loss weight: penalize max(0,abs(c)-sign(c)*predicted_effect)^2. It prefers agreement with a verified local direction without asserting the whole-window raw return must have that sign. Weight verified histories equally, then credit-bearing sources and backgrounds equally. If there is no verified example the raw solution is exact. Rotate credit one source within the same donor history, stage and preceding action; drop unknown raw in every version. A single relation label is a diagnostic and is excluded when evaluating its own history.
policy: Per terminal source freeze raw, margin and rotated edge scores. Allocate .80 times softmax([0,activity,relation]/.05) plus .20 times the checkpoint native three-action distribution at the verified actual state. This keeps mass on actions whose native conditional probability is very small. Compare full margin, raw-only, independently rotated labels, activity-only credit, relation-only credit, native, 20% native plus 80% uniform, three fixed actions and physical-question-weighted constant skill rates. Publish realized distributions, paired differences by history, exact within-window expected F1, and both conditional and constant-use controls. Count a strictly prospective window only when its earlier two-skill branch scores and semantic write/pair were all absent at forecast freeze.
decision: Training-panel feasibility only. Require the complete registered panel at at least 90% question coverage in the later evaluation block, +.02 vs native, positive gains over raw, rotated, smooth-uniform, the highest fixed skill and the matched rates, positive strict over native/raw and wins over raw in at least four later evaluation histories. Failure or missing coverage defers independent evaluation. Complete independent LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S gates remain necessary for any generalization claim.
